title: fix(play): exclude hidden references for models without image input
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16355

- Limits Play reference inputs to the selected model's image-input capability across generation requests and displayed/copied URLs.
- Keeps stored attachments for switching back to a capable model; uses a small pure selector in the existing model-selection module.
- Adds capability/state-preservation unit coverage. An actual-component state probe has three failing non-capable switches before the fix and six passing cases afterward, including image/text/video requests, URL copies, and switchbacks.
- Verification: all 66 website tests, full SDK/UI/website build, website typecheck, Biome, and independent unit/component checks pass. Component probe uses presentation stand-ins and synthetic responses; no live provider calls or Pollen used.

gist.headline: References know when to wait
gist.blurb: Play keeps reference images tucked away when the selected model can’t read them. Switch back to an image-capable model, and they’re still there.
gist.summary: Play filters reference images by the selected model’s image-input capability in image, text, and video requests and in displayed or copied URLs, while preserving attachments for model switchbacks.
gist.impact: Selecting a model without image input leaves references out of requests and copied URLs without deleting the images you attached.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Play’s model selector as a small switchboard: reference-image cards rest safely in a drawer when the selected model cannot accept images, then remain ready for an image-capable model. Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, gently closes the image-input gate; a code-plant grows beside the retro controls.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art workshop, Polli wears a tiny tool belt and gently closes an image-input gate on a retro model switchboard, leaving little reference-image cards safe in a drawer beside a growing code-plant.
